add_definitions(
    -D_WINE)

spec2def(msvidc32.dll msvidc32.spec)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# msvidc32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msvidc32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(msvidc32_shims OBJECT msvideo1.c)
target_link_libraries(msvidc32_shims PRIVATE wine libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(msvidc32_shims)
add_cargo_module(msvidc32 msvidc32-cargo msvidc32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msvidc32_shims psdk)
